lead_internal_arc.Elena March: From a fragmented, avoidant woman haunted by a blank childhood summer to a whole person who confronts the guilt of Tomas's drowning, chooses to reintegrate her severed self, and accepts the weight of living with the full truth.
lead_internal_arc.The Girl in Blue: From a silent, trapped reflection — the abandoned eight-year-old self — yearning to be remembered and reunited, to being acknowledged and reintegrated into Elena, allowing both to become one complete soul.
